question: What data is available and what can we analyze with it?
interpretation: Answer schema questions from the provided schema, without inventing tables. Explain the four tables, their grain and the access rules: product and order data are scoped to authorized brands, customer demographics are aggregate-only, direct contact details are never available. Optionally run one cheap query for the covered date range and volume.
metric_definitions: items = COUNT(*) of order_items in scope
sql:
SELECT MIN(DATE(oi.created_at)) AS first_date,
  MAX(DATE(oi.created_at)) AS last_date,
  COUNT(*) AS items,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS products
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
analyst_report:
Available data: orders (order-level status and timestamps), order_items (one row per item with price and status), products (catalog with brand, category, cost) and users (customer attributes, aggregate-only).
Scope: your authorized brands from <first_date> to <last_date>, <items> items.
You can analyze: revenue and margin trends, product and brand performance, customer value by ID, and aggregate demographics.
Not available: marketing spend, return reasons, customer contact details.
